newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia aiming for high economic growth-Costello.
newsitem.headline: Australia aiming for high economic growth-Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Friday the government was focussed on boosting economic growth and maintaining it at a high level.
"This government believes that growth is very important and we are putting in place the measures that can get growth up and keep it up," Costello told Channel Seven television.
